references.text: The glory of the Lord appeared at the tent of meeting before the whole congregation, just as in Korah's rebellion
Moses and Aaron went to the entrance of the tent of meeting, and the glory of the Lord appeared to them
The glory of the Lord appeared in the cloud, a parallel to the revelation of God's glory to the congregation
The glory of the Lord filled the tabernacle, showing the manifestation of God's presence at the tent of meeting
The glory of the Lord appeared before all the people, similar to the revelation of God's glory to the congregation
Later in the same chapter, the congregation gathered against Moses and Aaron, and the glory of the Lord appeared again
The cloud covered the tabernacle and the glory of the Lord appeared, a continuation of the same sequence of events
